edges.description: ITK phosphorylates PLC-gamma-1 downstream of the T-cell receptor; without it, IP3 generation and calcium release from intracellular stores fail.
Invariant NKT-cell development and maturation require ITK-dependent TCR signalling.
ITK-dependent TCR signalling supports thymic selection and peripheral maintenance of CD4 T cells; its loss produces progressive CD4 lymphopenia.
Defective TCR signalling impairs the antiviral T-cell response that keeps EBV-infected B cells in check.
Patient T cells secrete little IFN-gamma after TCR stimulation.
Patient T cells fail to upregulate Fas ligand after CD3/CD28 stimulation but respond normally when PMA and ionomycin bypass the TCR.

A role for iNKT cells in controlling EBV has been postulated because they are reduced in several EBV-susceptibility disorders, but disorders with global NKT-cell loss are not EBV-susceptible, so the contribution is unsettled.
Uncontrolled EBV replication gives persistent high-level viremia.
Uncontrolled EBV-infected B cells proliferate.
Hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis follows EBV infection in a minority of patients.
EBV persists in smooth muscle tumor cells, including when blood EBV serology is negative.
B-cell expansion presents as polymorphic EBV-positive lymphoproliferative disease.
Neoplastic B-cell clones arising from EBV-driven hyperplasia progress to classic Hodgkin lymphoma.
EBV-driven lymphoproliferation can progress to large B-cell lymphoma.
Pulmonary nodules are extranodal EBV-positive polyclonal B-cell proliferation.
Lymphadenopathy accompanies the mononucleosis-like EBV lymphoproliferative picture.
Hepatosplenomegaly accompanies the mononucleosis-like EBV lymphoproliferative picture.
Deficient IFN-gamma immunity underlies severe tuberculosis in EBV-naive patients.
Impaired removal of activated T cells is proposed to underlie the autoimmune manifestations seen in some patients.
T-cell depletion contributes to the infectious susceptibility that is poorly controlled by antimicrobials.
Progressive T-cell decline predisposed an index patient to fatal Pneumocystis pneumonia.
Hypogammaglobulinemia contributes to the infectious susceptibility that is poorly controlled by antimicrobials.
The knockout reproduces the reduced and immature NKT-cell compartment seen in patients.

nodes.description: Germline biallelic ITK variants abolish or destabilize the IL-2-inducible T-cell kinase, a Tec-family non-receptor tyrosine kinase expressed in T cells, NK cells, invariant NKT cells and mast cells. The index R335W allele is predicted to destabilize the SH2 domain and the mutant protein is nearly undetectable when expressed; other alleles truncate the protein or shorten its half-life.

The authors propose failure of Fas-mediated activation-induced cell death as a mechanism for the T-cell lymphoproliferation; activation-induced cell death itself could not be measured in the patient.

nodes.description: After TCR engagement, ITK is recruited to the LAT-SLP76 complex and activates PLC-gamma-1, which generates IP3 and diacylglycerol; IP3 releases calcium from the endoplasmic reticulum and drives NFAT nuclear translocation. Patient T-cell lines show reduced or nearly absent TCR-induced cytosolic calcium release.

Nodal and extranodal (especially pulmonary) disease often occur together.
